entities.summary: Marshon Lattimore is an American professional football cornerback. He played college football for the Ohio State Buckeyes and was selected by the New Orleans Saints in the first round of the 2017 NFL draft. Lattimore was named the 2017 Defensive Rookie of the Year and made four Pro Bowls with the Saints before being traded to the Washington Commanders midway through the 2024 season.
